text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins)
Notification 2013
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 26th April 2013 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.
